message.text:
Derived metadata is computed by memopayload.RebuildMemoPayload. Earlier exploration covered this mechanism.

RebuildMemoPayload lives in server/runner/memopayload/runner.go. It runs during CreateMemo and UpdateMemo when content changes. It extracts tags, mentions, and properties via MarkdownService.ExtractAll. I am checking for other computation sites and what Property contains.
I'll trace how memo payload metadata is derived, what triggers a rebuild, and what fields get extracted.

args.command:
grep -n -E "RebuildMemoPayload|ExtractAll|Payload|ExtractProperties|ExtractTags" --include='*.go' -r /bench/repo/server/router/api/v1 /bench/repo/server/runner/memopayload /bench/repo/internal/markdown --exclude='*_test.go' | grep -v proto/gen
echo "==== MemoPayload proto ===="
grep -n -A 40 "message MemoPayload" /bench/repo/proto/gen/store/memo.pb.go | head -5
grep -n -A 60 "message MemoPayload" /bench/repo/proto/store/memo.proto

message.text:
ExtractAll computes derived metadata. RebuildMemoPayload stores Tags and Property fields in the payload. Mentions are extracted but kept separate via memo_mention_helpers. Recomputation triggers on CreateMemo and on UpdateMemo when content changes.

memopayload.Runner.RunOnce is unused in production. ExtractAll and ExtractProperties will be inspected next to list the exact extracted properties.

The computation site is `memopayload.RebuildMemoPayload` → `markdown.Service.ExtractAll`. It runs on `CreateMemo` and `UpdateMemo` when the update mask includes "content". The extracted properties are not yet identified.

`Runner.RunOnce` performs batch rebuilds but is not wired at startup. `RebuildMemoPayload` stores tags, a property flag, and the first H1 title. Mentions are extracted in the same pass but are not written to the payload. The remaining details are still being gathered.

h14.
memopayload.RebuildMemoPayload (server/runner/memopayload/runner.go) via markdown.Service.ExtractAll; CreateMemo always, UpdateMemo when content changes; tags plus Property (has_link, has_task_list, has_code, has_incomplete_tasks, title)

Create and content-updating `UpdateMemo` call `RebuildMemoPayload`, which parses memo content once and writes `Payload.Tags` and `Payload.Property`. `ExtractAll` also collects `@mentions`, but those are not stored on the payload (mentions drive notifications in `memo_mention_helpers.go`). Location is user-set, not derived. `Runner.RunOnce` can rebuild all memos but is not started in production.
